svg.title: Recollect high-level architecture
svg.desc: Browser, Amplify hosting, Cognito and API Gateway in front of a Java Lambda with SnapStart. Files upload directly to S3; S3 events flow through SQS to an ingestion coordinator that drives a Bedrock Knowledge Base (Data Automation parser, Titan embeddings, S3 Vectors). DynamoDB holds application state. EventBridge runs the status reconciler and stale-document cleanup; CloudWatch alarms notify through SNS.
